ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% low-intensity (black) to 25% high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white pixel clusters are concentrated in the lateral regions of both lobes. The right lobe contains a dense network of linear white streaks; the left lobe displays a more amorphous, mottled white cluster near the center-left.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow U-shaped central depression with an estimated interior angle of 120 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated profile consisting of high-frequency, low-amplitude triangular peaks (sawtooth pattern) along the entire visible trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward curve extending from the medial notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, circular, isolated white pixel clusters localized at the extreme outer tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct parallel and intersecting white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible on the right lobe, with fewer diagonal streaks on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake mark scarring manifest as high-contrast white linear patterns against the dark ventral surface, primarily concentrated on the right lobe.
